headline: Symbotic Shares Rise 12% After Fourth-Quarter Results Beat Estimates
summary: Symbotic shares surged 12% after the supply chain automation company reported fourth-quarter 2026 financial results that exceeded Wall Street estimates.
why: Symbotic develops AI-powered robotic platform technologies for commercial warehouse automation and supply chain operations.

impacts.name: Symbotic
impacts.why: Symbotic shares rose 12% following quarterly earnings and revenue that exceeded market forecasts.
